import numpy as np
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as R

# --- Helpers ---
def quat_wxyz_to_rot(q):
    w, x, y, z = q
    return R.from_quat([x, y, z, w])

def rot_to_quat_wxyz(r):
    x, y, z, w = r.as_quat()
    return np.array([w, x, y, z])

# --- Perceive ---
nut_center_pos, nut_center_quat = get_object_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
peg_pos, peg_quat = get_object_pose("brown square block")
grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")

# --- Grasp the nut by its handle ---
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift straight up
lift_pos = grasp_pos.copy()
lift_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# --- Compute rigid transform between nut center and gripper (at grasp time) ---
R_nut = quat_wxyz_to_rot(nut_center_quat)
R_grasp = quat_wxyz_to_rot(grasp_quat)
# gripper pose expressed in nut-center frame
R_nut_to_grasp = R_nut.inv() * R_grasp
t_nut_to_grasp = R_nut.inv().apply(grasp_pos - nut_center_pos)

# --- Desired nut center pose: aligned with the peg, same orientation as peg (yaw) ---
R_peg = quat_wxyz_to_rot(peg_quat)
# Keep nut's original roll/pitch (it lies flat), only match peg yaw to align square hole with square peg
peg_yaw = R_peg.as_euler("xyz")[2]
nut_rpy = R_nut.as_euler("xyz")
R_nut_target = R.from_euler("xyz", [nut_rpy[0], nut_rpy[1], peg_yaw])

# Nut center target: directly above the peg (xy), slightly above peg top for the approach
nut_target_pos = np.array([peg_pos[0], peg_pos[1], peg_pos[2]])

# Corresponding gripper pose
ee_target_pos = nut_target_pos + R_nut_target.apply(t_nut_to_grasp)
ee_target_rot = R_nut_target * R_nut_to_grasp
ee_target_quat = rot_to_quat_wxyz(ee_target_rot)

# --- Move above the peg at a safe height, then insert ---
pre_insert_pos = ee_target_pos.copy()
pre_insert_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(pre_insert_pos, ee_target_quat)

# Insert downward onto the peg
goto_pose(ee_target_pos, ee_target_quat, z_approach=0.10)

# --- Release and retreat ---
open_gripper()
retreat_pos = ee_target_pos.copy()
retreat_pos[2] += 0.15
goto_pose(retreat_pos, ee_target_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
